verdict.rationale: Bolt documents an in-builder preview that you can edit directly. Its WebContainer runs Vite and Node servers in the browser, so the app is live while you build, and publishing to bolt.host is a separate later step. A hands-on user also describes building a working app inside Bolt. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on clicking through and testing the running preview before publish, and independent corroboration of how reliable the preview is.

support.subject: As a founder, I can interact with a live preview of my app while building, before publishing

citations.quote: Visual edits let you change how your project looks directly in the preview.

Install and run npm tools and libraries (like Vite, Next.js, and more)
  - Run Node.js servers
Bolt.new gives AI models complete control over the entire environment including the filesystem, node server, package manager, terminal, and browser console.
Bolt offers built-in hosting, so you can publish your Bolt project for free at a web address ending in `bolt.host`.
